unverified: Virginia allows golf carts only on designated streets posted 25 mph or less. Colonial Beach's designated-street list is not digitized, so plain golf carts stay red except tagged cart paths. State Route 205 is banned on top of that.

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.

cart_only_bans.label: Colonial Beach Code Sec. 14-95: golf carts may not be operated on State Route 205, and may cross it only at a designated golf cart crossing
